name: Savanna Private Game
insider_take: This isn't just a safari lodge—it's your front-row seat to one of Africa's most pristine wilderness theaters, where elephants might just stroll past your suite while you sip morning coffee.
whats_special: Savanna Private Game Reserve sits on 7,500 hectares of untouched African bushveld, home to the Big Five and over 350 bird species. The lodge features just 9 luxury suites, ensuring an intimate safari experience with some of the continent's best game viewing ratios—often less than 2 guests per square kilometer of pristine wilderness.
pro_tip: Book during the dry season (May-September) when animals congregate around water sources, making wildlife spotting practically guaranteed. The lodge's elevated position offers stunning panoramic views that are perfect for photography during golden hour.
dont_miss: The guided night drives reveal a completely different side of the African bush—from prowling leopards to the haunting calls of hyenas. Also, the nearby Blyde River Canyon, one of the world's largest green canyons, is just a scenic drive away and offers breathtaking views from God's Window viewpoint.
pros: Personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Limited dining options in surrounding area
This property is not available for online booking.
